Samsung Electronics wins $200 billion chip partnership with Broadcom

Samsung Electronics and US chip designer Broadcom agreed on a $200 billion partnership for cooperation across memory chips, contract chip making, and advanced packaging. The deal is expected to last until 2030. Samsung will supply chips to Broadcom. The partnership aims to widen cooperation between the two companies.
